dct_description_sm: The goal of research was to describe the soil characteristics associated with the discrete geomorphic zones of five stabilized retrogressive thaw slumps and two undisturbed areas at Thetis Bay, Herschel Island, YT. The study sites used are one >250 year old disturbed site, two approximately 20 year old disturbed sites, two less than 10 year old disturbed sites, and two adjacent sites not disturbed by thaw slumping.
dct_title_s: Soil characteristics for a chronosequence of retrogressive thaw slumps, Thetis Bay, Herschel Island, YT, Canada
